LAW AND MOTION 302, ATTORNEY THOMAS PAOLI'S MOTION TO BE RELIEVED AS COUNSEL FOR PLAINTIFFS JOSE SANTIAGO AND JUANITA SANTIAGO. APPEARANCES. ARGUED AND THE COURT ORDERED AN IN-CAMERA HEARING IN CHAMBERS. COURT ORDERED THE RECORD OF THIS HEARING SEALED UNLESS PARTY OBTAINED APPROVAL OF THE COURT. AFTER EXAMINATION, THE COURT GRANTED ATTORNEY THOMAS PAOLI'S MOTION TO BE RELIEVED AS COUNSEL FOR PLAINTIFFS JOSE SANTIAGO AND JUANITA SANTIAGO ON THE CONDITION THAT: 1. COUNSEL WILL TRY TO OBTAIN A STIPULATION WITH ALL PARTIES FOR NOT OPPOSING A CONTINUANCE OF TRIAL, 2. COUNSEL TO SCHEDULE A SHORTENING TIME MOTION TO CONTINUE TRIAL, 3. COUNSEL WILL TRY TO RESOLVE MATTERS BEFORE THE TRIAL. COUNSEL TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED ORDER. HON. RONALD E. QUIDACHAY. REPORTER: BELDON YEE, CSR #2647
